mapper.select: SELECT WM.WITHDRAW_ID, WM.WITHDRAWAL_DATE, WR.WITHDRAWAL_REASON_ID, WR.WITHDRAWAL_REASON FROM withdrawal_member WM JOIN withdrawal_reason WR ON WM.WITHDRAWAL_REASON_ID = WR.WITHDRAWAL_REASON_ID ORDER BY WM.WITHDRAWAL_DATE DESC LIMIT #{searchVO.rowStart}, #{searchVO.displayRowCount}
